transport_audit.explanation: disable_streaming=True suppresses outward LangChain streaming; langchain-ollama1.1.0 internally requests streamed Ollama responses and aggregates them. Frozen code and dependency versions are identical for both arms. Raw run records are preserved; their stream:false field describes the outward interface, not the HTTP transport.

note: Host identity and installed versions recorded after model collection; per-run runtime fingerprints and the initial concurrency test are separately retained.
